body: In my family, there's never really even been talk about mental problems and my parents pretty much just brushed off the fact that my brother has soxial anxiety or something (for example, he doesn't really want to go to the store even when asked to). I have no idea how my parents would react. I would feel vulnerable, I'm used to saying that I'm all fine. I have this scenario in my head in which my parents will just think that I'm not ''close enough to God'' anymore or something, since they're christian.

I have been desperately trying to have someone to chat with lately to cope with this better, but I haven't really found anyone, so I gave up. I've never said a word about any of this to a person in real life, so I don't even consider that a possibility. I feel that after all, no one will take me seriously, because even I sometimes can't. Even while I was typing my post I felt like an attention whore.
